title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs
abstract: arXiv:2608.15432v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In formal verification, both the autoformalization of statements and automated proof search have been studied extensively. While automated proof search can produce a formal proof that compiles, the generated proof does not necessarily reflect how the natural-language argument arrives at its conclusion--a property we refer to as faithfulness. With faithfully formalized proofs, one can check the reasoning behind a human- or AI-written argument, and assist mathematicians in formalizing their proof sketches. However, it is particularly challenging due to misalignment of formal proof tactics and natural language reasoning. In this work, we rigorously describe a set of five necessary conditions a faithful formal proof must satisfy, and introduce Pistis, an agentic, oracle-guided proof search that produces formal Lean proofs that satisfy them. At its core is a novel faithfulness-preserving divide-and-conquer search, which we name OrderDecompose

translated_title: 证据是否以那种方式证明？对元素证明的忠实形式化
translated_abstract: 在形式验证中，语句的自动形式化和自动证明搜索已被广泛研究。虽然自动证明搜索可以生成一个能编译的形式证明，但生成的证明并不一定反映自然语言论证如何得出结论——这一特性我们称为忠实性。通过忠实形式化的证明，人们可以检查人类或AI编写的论证背后的推理，并协助数学家形式化他们的证明草图。然而，由于形式证明策略与自然语言推理之间的不匹配，这尤其具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们严格描述了一组忠实形式证明必须满足的五个必要条件，并引入了Pistis，一个代理式、由预言机指导的证明搜索，它生成满足这些条件的正式Lean证明。其核心是一种新颖的、保持忠实性的分而治之搜索方法，我们称之为OrderDecompose。
tldr: 本文提出了忠实形式化证明的五个必要条件，并开发了Pistis系统，通过OrderDecompose搜索方法生成符合这些条件的Lean证明，以弥合自然语言推理与形式证明之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper defines five necessary conditions for faithful formal proofs and introduces Pistis, an oracle-guided agentic proof search with the OrderDecompose method, to generate Lean proofs that align with natural-language reasoning.
